metadata.datasource: Measured off HARMAN technology, ILFORD DELTA 3200 PROFESSIONAL technical information (Nov 2018), MICROPHEN stock, 9 min at 20 C with intermittent agitation, Ilford's time for EI 3200, read off the 2010 edition's vector plot of the same curves (the 2018 sheet's bitmap repeats it, to 0.004 density median). Characteristic curve laid on agx's axis with mid-grey where a meter set to EI 3200 puts it on the sheet's relative axis made absolute by Ilford's ISO speed, ISO 1000 (measured in ID-11), placed at the speed point of the MICROPHEN development that meets ISO 6's contrast (7.7 min, between the sheet's 7 and 9 minute curves; 0.80 over 1.30 log H, 0.798 as interpolated), as if MICROPHEN gave ID-11's speed at that contrast (log H -2.595); the curve's own ISO speed point is ISO 1093; base + fog 0.276. Continued at its final gradient for 0.8 decades past the last plotted exposure. Spectral sensitivity: Ilford's wedge spectrogram to tungsten light (2856K), read as relative log sensitivity, as the other HARMAN sheets' are; it runs on to about 690 nm. One silver layer, carried as three identical channels.
